items.title: io.github.intuvance:initializer 2.12.1-intuvance.2 发布, Intuvance fork of the OpenMRS Initializer module. The Initializer processes the content of the configuration folder when it is found inside OpenMRS application data directory. This fork changes one behaviour, applied in four line processors: a content package line that declares no concept mappings, concept set members or answers, descriptions, or drug reference maps no longer deletes what the concept or drug already had. Upstream cleared each of those collections before reading the line, which silently destroyed a pre-populated database's terminology on its first boot. A line that does declare them still replaces them wholesale, so the upstream "the CSV wins" semantics are unchanged.

items.title:
ai.ravenroot:ravenroot-plugin-bundle 0.6.1-alpha.1 发布, Manifest schema, checksum, path-safety and reserved-namespace validation for
        drop-in plugin bundles (PLAT-12). A thin, zero-additional-dependency validator: it
        depends only on ravenroot-application-api, reusing PayloadJson/PayloadValue/PayloadLimits
        for manifest parsing rather than adding a YAML or JSON Schema library. Deliberately does
        not depend on ravenroot-core: this module never loads a class, never touches
        NodePackage/NodePackages, and is callable standalone by plugin.sh (build/validate/install)
        without pulling in the runtime.

items.title:
ai.ravenroot:ravenroot-observability-otel 0.6.1-alpha.1 发布, PLAT-01: the OpenTelemetry export bridge, spans, metrics and
        log-correlation identifiers derived from ai.ravenroot.api.application.ExecutionEvent, the
        same event ai.ravenroot.server.audit.StructuredExecutionLogger already consumes. Depends on
        ravenroot-application-api (the event shape) and ravenroot-core (ExecutionMonitor.subscribe,
        the only extension point this module uses) and nothing else in the ai.ravenroot tree. Neither
        of those two modules, nor ravenroot-application-api's other consumers, every third-party
        node package, depends on this one: the OpenTelemetry SDK is reachable from exactly one kind
        of caller, a composition root (RavenrootServerMain, RavenrootCliMain), which is what makes
        "no OpenTelemetry dependency in core" a property the compiler enforces rather than prose.
        Disabled unless RAVENROOT_OTEL_ENABLED is set; see
        TelemetryConfiguration. Every OpenTelemetry artifact here is Apache License 2.0; this module
        has not been through the release SBOM and licence scan and should be before it
        ships in a tagged release.

app.doqa:doqa-client 0.1.9 发布, Reusable JVM client core for the DoQA Autotest API: configuration resolution
        (system properties over environment over properties file), model builders serializing
        to the API contract, an HTTP client with token auth, retries and timeouts,
        run-selection modes, and an Allure-compatible file sink. No runtime dependencies:
        HTTP via java.net.http (JDK 11+), JSON via a small built-in codec, so any
        test-framework adapter can build on top of it.

io.github.jamestoney311:org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.emitter.csv 1.0.13-beta.2 发布, CSV Report Emitter Plugin for BIRT

BIRT (Business Intelligence Reporting Tools) is an open source Eclipse-based set of reporting and data visualization tools and technologies used to build rich information applications, in particular, web applications based on Java and J2EE.

The CSV Report Emitter plugin for BIRT is an Eclipse based emitter plugin which outputs and displays your BIRT report in CSV Format.

The CSV Report Emitter plugin currently supports emitting DateFormatConverter.java single table within DateFormatConverter.java report design with Column Headers as First Row. This emitter handles Row/Cell level hidden properties while emitting the output.

items.title:
cn.com.keelbase:keelbase4j-core 0.1.2 发布, The embeddable runtime core: everything the runtime is, except the decision to be an application.
    An application that already exists — a host platform, say — puts this jar on its classpath and gets
    the trust loop, the governance surface and the security filter chain through one auto-configuration;
    keelbase4j-runtime is the thin application that does the same thing for a standalone deployment.
    What is deliberately absent here is the application's half: no server configuration, no datasource
    of its own, no context path (ADR-0017 D4/D5).
